Automatic Picture Transmission，模拟图像，普通 S: Automatic Picture Transmission: analogue images that any ordinary SDR can receive.
L 波段高分辨率图像，需定向高增益天线与下变频。: L-band high-resolution images, requiring a directional high-gain antenna and a down-converter.
Low Rate Picture Transmission，数字高分辨率图像。: Low Rate Picture Transmission: digital high-resolution images.
RTL-SDR 接收棒 + 电脑即可接收 137 MHz 气象卫星，无需执照。: An RTL-SDR dongle plus a computer is enough to receive the 137 MHz weather satellites — no licence required.
SDR# / GQRX / SatDump，设为 WFM 模式、带宽 40 kH: SDR# / GQRX / SatDump, set to WFM mode with 40 kHz bandwidth.
V 形偶极：两臂各约 53 cm、夹角约 120°，水平架设、开口朝南。: V-dipole: two arms of about 53 cm each at an angle of about 120°, mounted horizontally with the opening facing south.
俄罗斯卫星，LRPT 高分辨率彩色图像，现役主力。: Russian satellites providing high-resolution colour images by LRPT — the current mainstay.
卫星每次过境仅约 10–15 分钟，需提前查过境时间并守听。: Each pass lasts only about 10–15 minutes, so look up the pass time in advance and listen out for it.
四臂螺旋天线，气象卫星接收的优选全向天线。: A quadrifilar helix antenna — the omnidirectional antenna of choice for weather satellite reception.
在轨较久，APT 信号间歇、时有时无，接收需耐心。: Long in orbit, with an intermittent APT signal that comes and goes; reception takes patience.
已于 2025 年 6 月 6 日退役，仅作历史参考。: Retired on 6 June 2025; kept for historical reference only.
接收时选开阔地、避开高楼遮挡，天线朝向卫星来向。: Receive from open ground, clear of obstruction by tall buildings, with the antenna facing the direction the satellite arrives from.
查 NOAA 15/19 过境时间，开启 APT 录制提醒（提前几分钟通知）。: Look up the NOAA 15/19 pass times and turn on the APT recording reminder (which notifies you a few minutes early).
用 RTL-SDR（数十元）+ V 型偶极或 QFH 天线即可入门。: You can get started with an RTL-SDR (a few tens of yuan) plus a V-dipole or QFH antenna.
短波气象传真，用 SSB 接收各地气象台的气象图。: Shortwave weather facsimile: weather charts from weather services received on SSB.
自动图像传输，信号稳定，入门首选。: Automatic picture transmission with a stable signal — the first choice for beginners.
解码软件：SatDump、WXtoIMG（APT）；配合 Gpredict 预报: Decoding software: SatDump and WXtoIMG (APT), with Gpredict for pass predictions.
过境时录制 10–15 分钟 WAV，上传到 APT 解码器本地重建云图。: Record 10–15 minutes of WAV during the pass and upload it to the APT decoder to rebuild the cloud image locally.
静止气象卫星，需抛物面天线接收。: Geostationary weather satellites, received with a parabolic dish.
